title: Sequence freshness function not exported - replay attack vector
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs:678-684

The ll_seq_is_fresher() function implementing RFC-compliant sequence number comparison is defined inside mod tests - it is test-only and not available to production code. Callers cannot perform replay protection without reimplementing this logic.

Failure scenario: Caller has no library function for replay detection. They either skip it (replay vulnerable) or reimplement incorrectly (wrapping edge cases around 0x8000 boundary).

Fix: Move ll_seq_is_fresher to a public module function named seq_is_fresher(), document the half-window semantics, add doc tests.
close_reason: Already fixed: seq_is_fresher is exported at module scope (line 800) with full half-window semantics documentation and doc tests
